business_objective: Record exam-script bundle counts and custody handover, then close each bundle record after storage prerequisites are met.

stakeholder_statements.text: The invigilator creates an exam-script bundle record and identifies the examination, room, and declared script count.
The count checker records an independently counted script total and records whether it matches the declared count.
The invigilator records the bundle seal identifier and records handover to the examination clerk.
The examination clerk acknowledges receipt of the bundle.

The archive officer records the bundle as stored and closes the bundle record only after a matching count and examination-clerk acknowledgement are recorded. Script marking and result publication are outside this project.

business_objective: Review baggage-allowance corrections and update active bookings after the requested allowance is accepted.

stakeholder_statements.text: A traveler submits a baggage-entitlement correction and identifies the booking, current allowance, and requested allowance.
The booking agent confirms that the booking is active.
The fare records clerk records the baggage allowance attached to the fare.
The baggage service clerk records the requested allowance as accepted or declined and adds a reason when it is declined.

The itinerary clerk updates the booking to the accepted requested allowance only after active booking status and the fare allowance are recorded, then sends the outcome to the traveler. Baggage-fee collection and airport baggage handling are outside this project.

business_objective: Review temporary work-location declarations and record approved locations on employee profiles after coverage, protection, and policy checks.

stakeholder_statements.text: An employee submits a temporary work-location declaration and identifies the current work arrangement, proposed location, and intended period.
The line manager records business coverage as adequate or inadequate. The coverage criteria have not been agreed.
The information protection reviewer records the proposed location as acceptable or restricted and records any required condition. The location categories and risk criteria are not finalized.
The HR policy advisor records the declaration as compliant or non-compliant. The compliance criteria are undecided.

The workforce records clerk records the temporary location on the employee profile only after adequate coverage, an acceptable location outcome, and a compliant declaration are present, then sends the outcome to the employee. The delivery channel is undecided. Travel booking and expense reimbursement are outside this project.

business_objective: Review replacement translations of controlled documents and publish accepted versions after source alignment and language-quality checks.

stakeholder_statements.text: A document owner submits a translation-version replacement and identifies the controlled document, source version, translated version, and target language.
The translation coordinator records the translator declaration supplied with the translated version. The accepted declaration-evidence types have not been agreed.
The source alignment reviewer records the translated version as aligned or not aligned with the current source version. The alignment criteria are undecided.
The language quality reviewer records the translation as accepted or returned and adds a reason when it is returned. The quality criteria are not finalized.

The release clerk replaces the active translation only after source alignment and language-quality acceptance are recorded, then sends the outcome to the document owner. The delivery channel is undecided. Creating new source content and commissioning translation work are outside this project.

business_objective: Review construction-area handover readiness while preserving an unresolved rule about release when punch-list items remain open.

stakeholder_statements.text: A site manager submits an area-handover review and identifies the area, completion package, and requested handover status.

The completion inspector records the open punch items and a completion assessment. The inspector says the area may be released when only minor punch items remain open, but the categories of minor punch items are not finalized.
The safety reviewer records a safety clearance and any restrictions. The reviewer says the area must remain held whenever any punch item is open.
The client representative records acknowledgement of the handover documents.

The handover controller records the area as released or held after the completion assessment, safety clearance, and client acknowledgement are present. Nobody has decided which release rule controls, who resolves the disagreement, which requested handover statuses may be used, or the maximum decision time. Completing construction work and repairing defects are outside this project; the meeting also drifted into complaints about the site-office fan.
